Comet Bean Bake

A cozy bake with bright herbs.

Rowan Vale
Not the author

Long editorial technique text that is not the description.

Prep Time:
15 mins
Cook Time:
1 hr 5 mins
Total Time:
1 hr 20 mins
Servings:
4 to 6
Yield:
One comet-sized casserole
Rest Time:
10 mins

Ingredients

For the filling:

  • 12 1/2 ounces assorted moon beans and lentils (355 g), drained

  • 1½ cups plus 2 tablespoons cloud flour

  • 1 (28-ounce) can sky tomatoes

To finish:

  • Sea salt, to taste

Directions

  1. For the filling: Combine the beans.

    Stir in tomatoes.

  2. Bake until golden.

Special Equipment

Large baking dish, sturdy spoon

Notes

Drain the beans well.

Make-Ahead and Storage

Chill covered leftovers.
